title: 90% of US working hours are spent on tasks not covered well by AI benchmarks
script:
Ninety percent of US working hours are spent on tasks with little or no coverage from existing AI benchmarks.
Mercor mapped this labor index using data from the US Bureau of Labor Statistics.
The Mercor Benchmark Map identifies how well current models perform against these specific labor requirements.
Only ten percent of total American work time aligns with current AI performance metrics.
This data shows that most professional duties currently exist outside the scope of AI evaluation.
Employers using Mercor's scores to hire or promote might miss the full picture of human utility.
Would you trust an AI benchmark to grade your specific job performance?
